summary: Deployed feature broken—filter shows all, not uncategorised only
detailed_context: Nick is reporting a functional defect in v1.4.4 that was just deployed. The UI correctly displays '7 transactions needing categorisation,' but clicking that link returns *all* transactions instead of filtering to only the 7 uncategorised ones. This is a clear miss between intended behavior and actual behavior. The tone is calm but frustrated—the feature doesn't work as promised. Needs debugging before this counts as a successful deployment.
